name: @keepkey/device-protocol
description: The proto buffer files from the KeepKey device, packed for consumption by the client.

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:json && npm run build:postprocess
scripts.build:js: mkdir -p ./lib && ./node_modules/.bin/grpc_tools_node_protoc --plugin=protoc-gen-ts=./node_modules/.bin/protoc-gen-ts --js_out=import_style=commonjs,binary:./lib --ts_out=./lib types.proto messages.proto messages-ethereum.proto messages-eos.proto messages-nano.proto messages-cosmos.proto messages-binance.proto messages-ripple.proto messages-tendermint.proto messages-thorchain.proto messages-osmosis.proto messages-mayachain.proto messages-solana.proto messages-tron.proto messages-ton.proto messages-zcash.proto messages-hive.proto messages-near.proto
